description: This file defines the class `BuzzPhotoDecorator`, which is a decorator class providing additional functionality (like safe access to the photo resource) for the `BuzzPhoto` entity in the OrangeHRM system. It manages how the photo data is retrieved and processed.

classes.name: BuzzPhotoDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that adds functionality to the `BuzzPhoto` entity, particularly for retrieving the photo resource as a string.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a `BuzzPhoto` object.

methods.name: getBuzzPhoto
methods.description: Protected method to access the underlying `BuzzPhoto` entity.

methods.name: getPhoto
methods.description: Returns the photo as a string, converting from resource if necessary.
